invariants.rationale: The method is called on an instance, so 'this' must not be null.
The method accesses 'style.background', so 'style' must be non-null to prevent NullPointerException.
Preferred width of a UI element is generally non-negative.
'prefSizeInvalid' is a boolean, so it is either true or false.
'wrap' is also a boolean, so it is either true or false.
